q1_issues.issue: The elliptical second conjunct "(in) public" is a circumstantial adverbial meaning "publicly / in the open", not a place, so (Location sk_perform_1 public) asserts a spatial filler named public that the phrase does not name — the PP does not really answer "where".

q2_gaps: The circumstantial idiom "in public" / "in private" — neither a Location (it names no place), nor a Manner (the surface is a PP, and the Manner slot is specified for adverbs, -ly form preserved), nor the framing/domain In-oblique.

Coordination inside an oblique PP ("performed in homes and (in) public"): the coordinated-NP default is distributive, which read strictly would replicate the whole predication into two perform events; the instruction set carves out no exception for a shared event bearing two oblique atoms, which is what the parse (sensibly) does.

A bare-plural oblique object ("in homes"): the oblique's-object-NP rule names only articles (mint a witness) and bare mass / domain / proper names (stay a constant), so a bare plural count noun has no stated treatment.
notes: The name/kind split is handled exactly per the mechanical casing rule — the capitalized run "Durga" is the name symbol and the adjacent lowercase common noun becomes the ordinary type atom (Member durga puja), with no durga_puja fusion. Agentless passive and the no-status-atom generic default are both correct.
